**14 benchmarks, 17150 trials per arm.** 2 of 14 deltas significant at 95% (**\***): gsm8k (+11.8pp at 0.80× tokens) and mmlu_pro (+4.2pp at 0.88× tokens). All four harder-benchmark additions trend positive; direction-consistent across the slate. Difficulty is anchored to our classic arm.

Slate studies (2026-09-16/17): GPQA Diamond (#96), AIME 2024+2025 (#97), MMLU-Pro stratified-800 (#98), LiveCodeBench v6-150 (#99); stage-1 full test sets (10 benchmarks) from 2026-09-13 (#50 wave). Zero infra errors in all harder-slate runs.
